chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from someone who narrated to him, from Abdillah ibn Waddah, from Dawud al-Hammār, from Abū 'Abdillāh (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever does not visit the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him) has been deprived of much good, and one year will be reduced from his lifespan.
ai.seo_question: What are the consequences of neglecting the Ziyarah of Imam Husayn's grave?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s seminal work *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith underscores the profound ontological link between the Ahl al-Bayt and the believer’s worldly well-being, a concept central to Shia devotional practice. It posits that neglecting the visitation to Imam al-Ḥusayn (a.s.) not only deprives one of spiritual abundance but also incurs a tangible reduction in lifespan, reflecting the Shia belief in the intercessory and life-sustaining power of the Imams.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Ismā’īl, from someone who narrated to him, from ‘Abdillāh ibn Waďďāḥ, from Dāwūd Al-Ḥammār, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
Those who do not go to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) will be deprived of many great blessings and one year will be reduced from their lifespan.
